Workforce stability for Idaho employers

Child care is workforce infrastructure.

Most Idaho employers do not have a child care line item. The cost still shows up in turnover, absences and shifts you cannot cover. Idaho Families Work helps employers reduce that friction — starting with practical no-cost and low-cost changes.
